name: 4C+19.44 (Hubble)
blurb: 4C+19.44, a quasar with a long, straight jet, seen by Hubble.
label: 4c1944-hubble
story: A massive black hole at this galaxy's core drives a straight jet about three hundred thousand light-years long, the longest and straightest quasar jet with deep X-ray observations.

claims.text: 4C+19.44 is a quasar with a straight jet about three hundred thousand light-years long
Its jet is the longest and straightest quasar jet with deep X-ray observations; alternate name PKS 1354+195
The jet was studied in radio, infrared, optical (Hubble) and X-ray light
